tests.title: A deposit adds to the balance
A transfer moves money between wallets
Lists a wallet's transactions, newest first
Can't spend more than the balance
Frozen wallets can't send or receive

bugs.why: the transfer endpoint is mapped to /api/transfer, so POST /api/transfers gets a 404
bugs.fix: The path is /transfers (plural), as in the README: @PostMapping("/transfers").

bugs.why: the transactions endpoint binds @PathVariable("walletId"), but the path variable is {id}, so every request fails with a server error
bugs.fix: Bind the variable the path declares: @PathVariable("id").

bugs.why: the endpoint reads the filter from ?kind= instead of ?type=, so the type filter is ignored
a transfer takes the money out of the sender before checking the recipient, so a transfer to a missing or frozen wallet loses the money
bugs.fix: Look up and check both wallets (and the balance) before recording either side.
